title: Bulgarian — ISO 9:1995
authority: ISO 9:1995 (Information and documentation — Transliteration of Cyrillic characters into Latin characters)
description: Language-independent one-to-one Cyrillic transliteration applied to Bulgarian: Щ→ŝ, Ъ→ʺ, Ь→ʹ, Ю→û, Я→â, with č/š/ž, c and j. Fully reversible, no context rules; used in documentation and bibliographic work rather than for names in documents.
notes: Ъ is U+02BA MODIFIER LETTER DOUBLE PRIME and Ь is U+02B9 MODIFIER LETTER PRIME, as in the ISO 9:1995 table.
ISO/R 9:1968 differs for Bulgarian (щ→št, ъ→ǎ, ю→ju, я→ja); that system corresponds to bg_bds_1596.
Archaic ѣ→ě and ѫ→ǎ follow ISO 9:1995; accented ѝ→ì and ѐ→è are the ISO 9 values for U+045D/U+0450.
No special rule for word-final -ия or for the State name (България → Bʺlgariâ).
